keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Viery (Fiorentina).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Luca Ranieri replaces Viery because of an injury.
Goal! Monza 1, Fiorentina 0. Gustavo Varela (Monza) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Alieu Njie replaces Pote.
Goal! Monza 2, Fiorentina 0. Gustavo Varela (Monza) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Matteo Pessina with a cross following a fast break.
Goal! Monza 3, Fiorentina 0. Jay Robinson (Monza) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Valde replaces Wilfried Gnonto.
Substitution, Fiorentina. Beto replaces Franco Mastantuono.
Substitution, Monza. Dany Mota replaces Jay Robinson.
Substitution, Monza. Manga Foe Ondoa replaces Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
Substitution, Monza. Jan Ziólkowski replaces Eddy Kouadio.
Radu Dragusin (Fiorentina) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Monza. Idrissa Touré replaces Matteo Pessina.
Substitution, Monza. Lorenzo Lucchesi replaces Samuele Birindelli.
